elysium.class.artificer.desc: Fleet and infrastructure engineering. Keeps gear alive and reforges it better.
elysium.class.enforcer.desc: The fleets' line soldier, and the Code's blunt instrument.
elysium.class.factor.desc: Imperial trade. Does not fight better - simply comes away with more.
elysium.class.marksman.desc: The long shot, taken from cover, once.
elysium.class.medicae.desc: Medical Regeneration, practised in the field. The only role that keeps anyone else standing.
elysium.class.psion.desc: The psionic elemental system, practised rather than merely carried.
elysium.class.reclaimer.desc: Singularity-forged neutronium comes from somewhere. This is who is down there getting it.
elysium.class.voidrunner.desc: Cybernetic enhancement, spent entirely on arriving first.
elysium.class.warden.desc: Modelled on Sentinel: what stands in the way when nobody is left to give orders.
elysium.command.respec: Every assigned point returned — %s to spend
elysium.favor.recognised: Favor: Recognised — the Unsworn are drawn to you
elysium.favor.unknown: The Empire does not know your name
elysium.passive.bulwark.desc: Below half health your whole reflected share is laid over itself.
elysium.passive.called_shot.desc: A critical hit deals 125% extra damage instead of 50%.
elysium.passive.cold_blood.desc: Deals up to 60% more damage as your health falls.
elysium.passive.field_repair.desc: Elysium gear wears a third slower. Reforges roll 50% higher.
elysium.passive.lightfeather.desc: Ignores the first ten blocks of any fall, and two thirds of the rest.
elysium.passive.molt.desc: Regeneration triples after five seconds without being hurt.
elysium.passive.photonic.desc: Double shield capacity. Takes a third less fire and blast damage, and 15% more of everything else.
elysium.passive.profiteer.desc: A further 25% chance of a second drop from anything that pays out.
elysium.passive.prospector.desc: A one in four chance of a second ingot from any Elysium vein.
elysium.passive.resonance.desc: Psionic potency raised by half: wider elemental advantage, stronger runes.
elysium.passive.sanctioned_answer.desc: Harm done to an Imperial is answered. Reflects a share of every blow, climbing with level toward 100% and never quite arriving: 9% at level 10, 33% at 50, 50% at 100, 80% at 400.
elysium.passive.sanctioned_force.desc: 25% more damage to the Unsworn. Earns 40% less Suspicion.
elysium.passive.triage_field.desc: Heals every player within eight blocks, and yourself half again faster.
elysium.passive.uncounted.desc: Suspicion sheds twice as fast. Favor comes half as easily.
elysium.race.druun.desc: Reptilian, of the Druun Ascendancy. Militaristic and steeply hierarchical; enormously strong and slow to think.
elysium.race.imperial.desc: Humanoid. The most common form across the Empire, and the only people with no weakness worth naming.
elysium.race.korrath.desc: Insectoid, of the Korrath Dominion. Hive-structured and rapidly expanding. Fast, evasive, and impossible to demoralise.
elysium.race.lumari.desc: Energy-based, of the Lumari Collective. Advanced, peaceful, and existing in forms that transcend traditional biology.
elysium.race.unsworn.desc: Outside the Code entirely. Lucky, quick, and worth nothing at all to the Empire.
elysium.race.veylari.desc: Avian, of the Veylari Concord. Isolationist and technologically advanced. Precise, clever, and barely armoured.
elysium.screen.choose: Declare yourself. This is recorded once.
elysium.stat.accuracy.desc: Chance to land a critical hit
elysium.stat.fortitude.desc: Armour you have without wearing any
elysium.stat.intellect.desc: Psionic potency: elemental advantage and rune strength
elysium.stat.luck.desc: Chance of more out of everything you kill
elysium.stat.presence.desc: How fast the Empire notices, and how well a reforge rolls
elysium.stat.reflexes.desc: Chance to avoid a blow outright
elysium.stat.resilience.desc: Cuts a share off everything that reaches you
elysium.stat.retribution.desc: Sends a share of every blow back at its owner
elysium.stat.strength.desc: Your base damage, before a weapon multiplies it
elysium.stat.vitality.desc: Passive health regeneration, and a little more of it to lose
elysium.tooltip.codex: Right-click to open your character sheet
elysium.tooltip.reforge_hint: Consumed at a Reforge Table to reroll stats
elysium.tooltip.rune_hint: Socket at a Rune Socket Table
